Container.Name: TorrServer
Container.Overview: TorrServer - stream torrents to http. Unofficial image with automatic TorrServer updates, peers blocklist and ffprobe. Additional settings are available in ts.ini in the config directory.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Disk cache (up to CacheSize, 5 GB by default) and autoload directory for .torrent files

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web port, used with bridge network only (should match TS_PORT)

Config.Name: Version
Config.Description: latest or a specific release, e.g. MatriX.147

Config.Name: Auto-update TorrServer
Config.Description: Update TorrServer at start and by schedule

Config.Name: Update schedule
Config.Description: Cron format, none - no scheduled updates

Config.Name: Peers blocklist URL
Config.Description: eMule ipfilter / p2p / plain list (zip, gz or text), none - disabled

Config.Name: Options
Config.Description: Extra TorrServer options, e.g. -a (http auth, users in accs.db)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run TorrServer as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run TorrServer as

Config.Name: Update OS packages
Config.Description: apt-get upgrade at start (slow, image is rebuilt weekly anyway)
